name: karim-expo
description: Expo platform integrations that are easy to get wrong. In-app purchases and subscriptions across RevenueCat, StoreKit 2 and Google Play Billing; animated splash screens with real launch-to-first-screen continuity via expo-splash-screen; and 3D/AR on the expo-gl canvas with three.js and React Three Fiber, including the native gotchas that do not appear in web tutorials.
